verdict.rationale: Fly.io is a cloud platform, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows only adjacent capabilities: Sprites host third-party agent harnesses like Claude and Codex, and an experimental flyctl MCP server exposes tools to external agents. Neither is a first-party assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
